## ARTICLE 12 SALARY RATES

### Section 12.1

The following shall apply to full time employees:

A. Effective January 2, 2000 employees who meet the eligibility criteria provided in Section 12.2 of this article shall receive a three percent (3%) increase in salary rate.

B. Effective January 1, 2001 a step 12 is established at 2% above the existing step 11 for each job group. For the purposes outlined in section 4 of this Article, employees who have occupied step 11 of their job group for 52 or more weeks of creditable service as of January 1, 2001 shall be provided with a date of next step increase in calendar year 2001 which corresponds to the month and day on which the employee received his/her most recent step increase. Employees who have occupied Step 11 of their job group for less than 52 weeks as of January 1, 2001 shall advance to Step 12 after fifty-two (52) weeks of creditable service in Step 11.

Effective January 7, 2001 employees who meet the eligibility criteria provided in Section 12.2 of this article shall receive a three percent (3%) increase in salary rate.

C. Effective January 6, 2002 employees who meet the eligibility criteria provided in Section 12.2 of this article shall receive a two and one-half percent (2.5%) increase in salary rate.

D. Employees hired prior to May 4, 1997 shall be paid in accordance with the salary schedules provided in Appendices A-1 through A-2 of this Agreement. Said employees shall be converted to the salary schedule provided in Appendix B-1 of this Agreement as follows:

1. Employees who, as of June 29, 1999, were paid at Step 7 on the salary schedule provided in Appendix A-1 shall, effective June 30, 1999, be paid at a salary rate on the salary schedule provided in Appendix B-1 equal to that which the employee received on the salary schedule provided in Appendix A-1. For the purposes outlined in Section 4 of this Article, said employees shall, upon conversion to the salary schedule provided in Appendix B-1, be provided with a date of next step increase in the next fiscal year which corresponds to the month and day on which the employee received his/her most recent step rate increase.
